subject: reasoning
question:
A square transparent sheet with a pattern is shown in the given figure. Find out from amongst the following options, as to how the pattern would appear when the transparent sheet is folded at the dotted line.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85db27b604c3c09da228b65b4fa45056a7207f5767e0392a0281960afd0061fe.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfb4301254b4ff11cc4528f7be829df98e0003a72421c00bd5c15737c916ada7.png]
solution:
The figure will appear when it is folded at the dotted line is shown as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69acb707fcfddd704d97ef42f077c4c3c0dd944f0f5b68939dc6fdf19932caed.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d318fc443933d631d5aa8af8f8d395769d5bba7b54f7a17ec7024bfaba85fdb6.png] 

Here, option figure 4 would appear when the transparent sheet is folded at the dotted line.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
